I know I'm not very established as a member, but I'm hoping to improve my writing skills by being on the site.

item.title: Re: Locked Page
item.content:encoded:
That does sound like significant professional experience.

The other conditions to being listed on this page, though, include willingness and availability to help users who try and contact you. I notice, at this time, your account is quite new (welcome!). A concern for staff, I reckon, is people being on the list, but then not being present enough to actually respond to requests for advice they'd get.

So, in this case, probably a bit of time to ease yourself into the community will be good. If you establish yourself as a helpful and frequent site member, then I expect the page can be edited to list you as a resource.

item.title: MTF/ agent weapons
item.content:encoded: just wondering if anyone here who is a gun nerd decided to take the time to write a firearms nerd section/requisition to what the SCP MTF would be issued? Ive broken down what MTF agents would be issued due to their AO(area of operation). There is no one issued weapon but due to recent events in NATO countries there has been a push to standardize 7.62 rifles in NATO countries. All small arms are dictated by local forces armaments, IE SCP agents in Eastern Europe use AK pattern rifles. Agents in Western Countries use 5.56 Nato rifles depending on the country IE, COLT Canada/LMT in the UK. LMT in NZ and COLT/FN in the US.
